    Approximate-unit limit lemmas for the quotient C*-identity (order-free) #

    The concrete limit lemma ‖m - m*u‖ → ‖q m‖. Imports ONLY the carrier (MatrixSeqQuotientBasic) — it does NOT import the spectral-order instances (L2NullApproxUnit), whose CFC-based PartialOrder/ StarOrderedRing on MatrixSeqAlg pervasively slow ALL elaboration in importing files. The order-derived fact this proof needs (‖1-u‖ ≤ 1) is taken as an opaque hypothesis hone; the C*-identity theorem supplies it (paying the order cost once, in that theorem alone).

    ‖1 - u‖ ≤ 1

    Generic: ‖1 - u‖ ≤ 1 for a positive contraction. Abstract A — no concrete-order unfolding.

    theorem ZFib.CEP.mul_one_sub_gen {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] (a b : R) :
    a * (1 - b) = a - a * b

    Generic ring identity (proved at abstract Ring R, dodging lp-subtype tactic opacity).

    theorem ZFib.CEP.sub_mul_split_gen {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] (m j u : R) :
    m - m * u = (m - j) * (1 - u) + j * (1 - u)

    Generic ring identity: the split used in the approximate-unit limit.

    theorem ZFib.CEP.norm_sub_mul_right_tendsto {dim : ℕ → ℕ} (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) (σ : (k : ℕ) → TracialState (MatrixAlg (dim k))) (m : ↥(MatrixSeqAlg dim)) (l : Filter ↥(MatrixSeqAlg dim)) (hne : l.NeBot) (hmem : ∀ᶠ (u : ↥(MatrixSeqAlg dim)) in l, u ∈ l2NullIdeal ω σ) (hone : ∀ᶠ (u : ↥(MatrixSeqAlg dim)) in l, ‖1 - u‖ ≤ 1) (hright : ∀ j ∈ l2NullIdeal ω σ, Filter.Tendsto (fun (u : ↥(MatrixSeqAlg dim)) => j * u) l (nhds j)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun (u : ↥(MatrixSeqAlg dim)) => ‖m - m * u‖) l (nhds ‖(q ω σ) m‖)

    The right approximate-unit limit: ‖m - m*u‖ → ‖q m‖. Order-free — the contraction bound ‖1-u‖ ≤ 1 enters as the opaque hypothesis hone.
